source: Sorted by reading data/contract-state-riders-v1.json. Edit scripts/make-state-checklist-data.mjs, not this file.
note: c: A = action (a line on the Before you send card), H = handled by the builder, B = background. A line with no entry is background. An action line with sys is done or seen by the system (sys_kinds says which); without sys it is ticked by a person. fact = the one-question fact the line depends on. No lawyer has reviewed this sorting.

homestead.en: Is this the customer's homestead (the home they own and live in)?
homestead.pt: Este imóvel é o homestead do cliente (a casa própria onde ele mora)?

subs.en: Will subcontractors or suppliers work on this job?
subs.pt: Subempreiteiros ou fornecedores vão participar deste serviço?
subs.known: The project already has a subcontractor assigned.

big_build.en: Is this a new home, or a remodel that costs more than half of the home's assessed value?
big_build.pt: É uma casa nova, ou uma reforma que custa mais da metade do valor avaliado da casa?

sale_english.en: Was the sale made in English?
sale_english.pt: A venda foi feita em inglês?

credit.en: Is the customer paying on credit (in installments or with a finance charge)?
credit.pt: O cliente vai pagar a crédito (parcelado ou com juros)?

age65.pt: O cliente tem 65 anos ou mais?

age62.pt: O cliente tem 62 anos ou mais?

insurance_paid.en: Is an insurance claim paying for this job?
insurance_paid.pt: Um seguro vai pagar este serviço?

note.en: Is the customer signing a promissory note?
note.pt: O cliente vai assinar uma nota promissória?

secured.en: Is payment secured by the customer's home (a lien or mortgage)?
secured.pt: O pagamento é garantido pela casa do cliente (gravame ou hipoteca)?

arbitration.known: Read from the dispute clause chosen in this contract.

arb_or_jury.known: Read from the dispute clause chosen in this contract.

license.pt: Confira se a sua licença ou registro vale para este serviço em {state}

license_local.pt: Confira se a cidade ou o condado exige licença local para este serviço

license_word.why: The contract's license line already uses the word this state uses.

license_number.why: Your number on file prints in the contract.

license_number#missing.en: Add your license or registration number in the document settings
license_number#missing.pt: Cadastre o número da sua licença ou registro nas configurações dos documentos

license_number#missing.sys_pt: O número da sua licença ou registro impresso no contrato

written_contract.why: This builder is the written contract.

cancellation.why: The contract states the right to cancel and counts the deadline.

cancellation_days.why: How the state counts the days. The builder does the counting.

cancellation_deadline.why: The builder computes the deadline and prints the federal notice and form.

cancellation_oral.en: Tell the customer out loud that they can cancel

notice#prints.why: This notice prints in the contract.

defect.why: How this state handles construction defect claims. Where the research gives a cite, the warranty and dispute clauses already point to it.

item.why: A summary line from the research.

status.why: How far the research for this state got.
